name: Flagsmith Cloud
description: Flagsmith Cloud manages feature flags, remote configuration, environments, segments, identities, experiments, and controlled releases.
agentUseSummary: Connect a view-only service-account token bound to one non-production project. Relay approval-gates bounded project feature metadata reads while values, states, environments, identities, owners, overrides, experiments, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: FLAGSMITH_CLOUD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Flagsmith Cloud service-account token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated service account restricted to view one project.

credentialRequirements.name: FLAGSMITH_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Flagsmith Cloud project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production numeric project.

capabilities.label: Read feature metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded project-level feature metadata with approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Service-account tokens and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read flag values or identities
blocked.description: Initial and multivariate values, environments, states, overrides, identities, owners, metadata, segments, experiments, and code references are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Flagsmith
blocked.description: Feature, state, environment, segment, identity, experiment, project, permission, token, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only project feature list and exact GETs run on api.flagsmith.com with stored project binding; arbitrary paths, queries, pagination, evaluation, exports, and self-hosted origins are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; project/view authority, fixed Cloud routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and value/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; project/view authority, fixed Cloud routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and value/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted project-view token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted project-view token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Flagsmith requires a customer organization, dedicated view-only service account/token, and one project. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the restricted staging account/token outside this worker, configure token and project ID in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: Flagsmith Cloud's live official OpenAPI pins token authentication, project feature list/exact GETs, pagination, response fields, and separate mutation routes.
Flagsmith documents Cloud feature flags, remote configuration, environments, SDKs, and the REST API.
